title: The Claims Record and the Benefit That Goes Across with a Transferred Piece
content:
**Does what happened on the claims record change how much benefit goes across with the piece?** On a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans it does, where a refusal stands on the plan in the 12 months to the handling date, and how much turns on the settlements standing over the life of the plan.

Where a refusal entry stands on the plan in the 12 months to the handling date and 2 or more settlement entries stand on it over its life, 80 percent of what would otherwise carry across is carried. Where a refusal entry stands in those 12 months and fewer than 2 settlement entries stand on the plan over its life, 90 percent of what would otherwise carry across is carried. In any other case the whole of what would otherwise carry across is carried.

## What each case carries

| Refusal entries in the 12 months to the handling date | Settlement entries over the life of the plan | The part carried of what would otherwise carry across |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | 2 or more | 80 percent |
| one or more | fewer than 2 | 90 percent |
| none | any | the whole of it |

**A plan with a refusal standing 14 whole months back and none since.** That refusal does not stand in the 12 months to the handling date, so the whole of what would otherwise carry across is carried.

**A plan with one refusal standing 3 whole months back and 4 settlements over its life.** A refusal stands in those 12 months and 2 or more settlements stand over the life of the plan, so 80 percent of what would otherwise carry across is carried.
